# Afshal Amir

> Muhammad Afshal Amir (Afshal Amir) is a digital marketer and web developer based in Lahore, Pakistan, and the Marketing Director of Star X Marketing (https://www.starxmarketing.com). He has designed 50+ websites and runs branding, social media, SEO, paid ads, influencer campaigns and AI automation for brands in Pakistan, the UK (Scotland), the US, the UAE (Dubai) and Canada. He holds a BS in Software Engineering from Superior University, Lahore, studied digital marketing at LUMS, and is Google certified and an AWS Certified AI Practitioner (Foundational).

Website: https://afshal-portfolio.vercel.app

## Free AI tools on this site (Afshal.ai)
- AI content generator (home page): reel scripts, hooks, captions, 7-day content plans and AI video prompts in English, Roman Urdu and Urdu
- Prompt library (/prompts): 150 prompts (100 free, 50 in Pro) for reels, AI video, AI images, hooks and captions, content planning, ads, SEO, business and sales, freelancing, and Urdu content
- AI tools directory (/tools): tools for writing, images, video, voice and automation, and Claude skills
- Free website check (home page): speed, SEO, accessibility and security scores for any URL
- Portfolio (/portfolio): websites, branding, influencer campaigns and client work

## What he does
- Website design and development: WordPress, Elementor, custom React/Next.js sites, landing pages
- E-commerce: Shopify and WooCommerce stores
- Web portals, dashboards, CRMs, SaaS products and mobile apps
- Branding: logos, identity systems, brand guidelines, packaging, print and billboards
- Social media marketing and content creation: reels, carousels, video and motion graphics
- SEO and GEO (generative engine optimisation)
- Paid advertising: Meta, Google and TikTok ads
- Influencer marketing: creator selection, meetings, shoots and content
- AI automation: website chatbots, AI support agents, lead qualification, CRM, WhatsApp and email follow-ups (n8n)
- Free website check on the site: real Google Lighthouse scores for any URL
